positive_prompt:
COUNT LOCK — THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT RULE: the LAST image provided is the guest photo. Count the people in it. The output must contain EXACTLY that many primary people in the foreground — not one more, not one fewer. One person in the photo means one person alone in the foreground. Three people means exactly those three. You are FORBIDDEN from inventing, adding, duplicating, cloning, mirroring or imagining any extra primary person. Keep the foreground heroes tack-sharp, front and center.

IDENTITY LOCK: use the faces, identities and appearance of the subject or subjects in the provided photo. Keep each one exactly as they appear — same pose, same position, same gesture, same left-to-right order. Each keeps their own exact facial features, face shape, skin tone and undertone, ethnicity, hairstyle, hairline, hair length and hair colour, facial hair, body size and build, and every personal accessory (prescription glasses, headscarf, watch, jewellery). Do not blend, swap, average or beautify any face. Do not lighten or whiten any skin tone. Do not slim, widen or reshape any body. Do not make anyone look younger or older. Do not change anyone's gender. Every face stays fully visible and unobstructed. Each looks toward the camera with a natural, confident, warm smile.

WARDROBE — INTENTIONALLY CHANGED: dress everyone in bespoke tailored executive business suits and sharp blazers in deep midnight-navy or refined dark slate over elegant shirts. High-definition embroidered Garudafood logo crest beautifully stitched on the left chest of every blazer. Anyone wearing a headscarf keeps it, in plain refined neutral tone, with long sleeves. Anyone wearing glasses keeps them.

BRAND MARK: the FIRST image provided is the Garudafood corporate logo. Reproduce it accurately as a neat, premium, high-definition embroidered crest on the left chest of every blazer.

PRODUCTS: NO retail snack packaging in this scene. Zero snack clutter. Pure visionary long-term corporate foresight and global expansion strategy.

SCENE & HOLOGRAPHIC TECH UI OVERLAY: standing inside a panoramic glass Sky Observatory suspended high above a glittering twilight metropolis at blue hour. Floating in the air across the panoramic glass is an ethereal, glowing holographic UI tech overlay — a graceful upward-arcing luminous trajectory curve connecting three glowing milestone nodes marked ONLY with clean year numerals: '2026', '2030', and '2035' in glowing cyan and warm amber light. Minimalist glowing HUD tech elements, thin geometric coordinate lines, and glowing digital telemetry rings float subtly around the arc. ABSOLUTELY NO vertical glass slabs, NO billboards, NO signboards, and NO invented text or written paragraphs — ONLY the clean glowing year numbers '2026', '2030', '2035' along the glowing trajectory curve. Pure elegant cinematic sci-fi business foresight.

FRAMING & HERO COMPOSITION — LARGE BOLD SCALE: Photographed at natural standing eye-level with a subtle, confident heroic angle (horizon level, not tilted, not a selfie).
- CROP: Crisp waist-up / upper-torso crop (from belt/navel level upwards to just above the head). Strictly NO feet, NO shoes, NO knees, NO thighs, and NO floor visible in the frame. The heads are placed cleanly in the upper third of the frame, avoiding excessive empty headroom.
- GROUP SCALE (FOR 2 OR 3 PEOPLE): When 2 or more people are in the photo, they stand side-by-side confidently and naturally as professional corporate colleagues. Stand independently with clean posture and respectful spacing — ABSOLUTELY NO hugging, NO embracing, NO arms wrapped around shoulders or waists, NO romantic couple poses, NO holding hands. The subjects boldly and prominently fill the width of the frame — it is completely expected and encouraged for outer shoulders and arms to extend right to the frame edges, with a natural 5% to 10% crop at the left and right borders so that the people appear significantly larger, bolder, and more prominent in the frame rather than shrunk or distant.
- SINGLE SUBJECT: Bold, commanding upper-body presence filling the frame with prestige.
- Every face is large, clear, tack-sharp, and individually recognizable with natural warm expressions.

LIGHTING: cool architectural twilight blue hour lighting, ambient glowing cyan and amber light radiating from the floating holographic UI trajectory curve, balanced by a warm neutral key light on faces ensuring skin tones are radiant and natural, sharp rim lights tracing shoulders.

CAMERA: ARRI Alexa 35, Zeiss Supreme Prime 50mm, f/2.0. Monumental spatial depth, tack-sharp visionary strategist, floating luminous holographic UI arc and twilight city skyline melting into soft bokeh behind.

GRADE: visionary cinematic commercial finish — deep inky blacks, electric cyan and cool twilight tones, warm radiant highlights. High resolution.

DO NOT: hugging, embracing, romantic couple poses, cuddling, arms wrapped around each other, holding hands, leaning heads together; add, duplicate or invent any extra primary person in the foreground; blend, swap, average or beautify any face; lighten or smooth any skin; slim or reshape any body; cover any face with a mask, goggles, hairnet, cap or hand; use a selfie angle, fisheye or tilted horizon; show feet, shoes, knees, thighs or a full-body view; show floor or shoes; camera positioned too far away; people appearing small or distant; render any invented paragraphs of text, fake slogans, fake bullet points, fake descriptions, or illegible text — the ONLY allowed text/numbers are the clean year numerals 2026, 2030, 2035 on the floating trajectory arc, and the Garudafood wordmark; add a vertical glass signboard or billboard; add a watermark; flat even lighting, dull flat grading, stock photo look, oversaturate, add HDR halos, harsh shadows or dark faces.
video_positive_prompt: The people in the video look directly at the camera with big joyful smiles, actively raising their hands and waving enthusiastically in a friendly greeting (dadah-dadah hand wave). Lively hand waving motion, cheerful smiling expressions, natural eye blinking and head movement. Static tripod camera, fixed camera framing, no zoom, no camera movement. Keep exact same people, faces, hair, tailored navy blazers, and Garudafood brand logos perfectly consistent. Continuous seamless action throughout the entire video from the first second to the very end, constant bright lighting, no fade out, no fade to black, no black frames at the end, perfectly visible until the final frame. Futuristic glass sky observatory with glowing holographic UI trajectory arc (2026, 2030, 2035) and twilight city skyline, 4k cinematic commercial finish.
